title: authoff left open (jmx) — review required
description: authoff runs with an open setting: com.sun.management.jmxremote.authenticates*=s*false. Open binds, trust auth, and disabled protections expose the service to unauthenticated networks. This lexical rule flags the setting; the reviewer confirms isolation or hardens it.
remediation: Apply authenticated JMX plus TLS and verify from an untrusted network.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the setting regardless of network isolation.
